en_before: Old Money and Dark Academia can share tailoring, knits and traditional colors. Dark Academia often gives more weight to darker literary imagery, while Old Money styling foregrounds imagined restrained leisure. These are tendencies rather than exclusive rules. Quiet Luxury shares restraint but need not use elite-sport, campus or country-club references. Preppy shares polos, Oxford shirts, cardigans and loafers, while allowing a broader set of collegiate or schoolwear interpretations.
